At the centered regular configuration q*=(d−1)/(d+1),t*=1/d, differentiation yields trace −2/d, determinant 1, and nonzero off-diagonal derivative. The eigenvalues cannot be roots of unity for integer d>=3 because their rational sum −2/d would then be a nonintegral rational algebraic integer. Thus the first coordinate of every F_d^N has nonzero t-derivative at t*. Each analytic return equation has isolated countable roots; their countable union excludes all finite returns. Every iterate remains nondegenerate with origin interior. Exact rational verifier passes 411 finite corroborating checks.
